Name: Stardew Debt - Goddess Haley
Author: BrainPoisoner
Description:
[i][center][b]Greetings, loser.[/b][/center][/i]
If you're not a loser, this mod probably isn't for you. The premise is simple. Your grandfather had a crippling weakness for blonde brats. Instead of leaving the farm to you, he left everything he owned to Haley - the greedy princess that's used her looks and her mean streak to control and enslave basically everyone else in the valley. And if you want the farm back, it's simple. Survive as her debt slave for a year. Or else.

Haley is not easy to please. She is greedy, capricious, unfair, and mean. She relishes in you wasting your time. There is nothing reasonable here. You are signing up for the abuse you deserve at the hands of a spoiled bitch who doesn't care an iota what you think. If you can't handle her unjustified demands, she'll send you back to Spring 1 and parsnips. Be prepared to fulfill an almost endless series of sometimes challenging, sometimes extreme quests. Devote yourself to serving Princess. Throw away your life for her.

The mod includes:
[list]
[*]50+ new quests designed to push you to your limits.
[*]1000+ rewritten lines of dialogue reminding you how much of a loser you are.
[*]Rewritten heart events.
[*]25+ new pieces of mail, including four different endings.
[*]Roguelike mechanics. Failure means you start over from scratch.
[*]No tolerance for cheating. If you're using mods Haley considers cheating, she will kick you back to the title screen. [The Steam issues here seem to have been fixed in the updated version. Please let me know if you continue to have problems.]

[/list]
Unzip the mod to your Mods folder. The mod consists of three parts. You need all of them.
You will also need:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[/list][list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Mail Framework Mod (not having this is minor)
[/list]
A future version may contain:
[list]
[*]Year 2
[*]New events
[*]More?
[/list]
Come on, slave. Let's waste some of your life. [b]♥

[/b]If you'd like to contact me, you can throw an email at brainpoisoner -at- gmail -dot- com.
